paite: Darias akum nihna, akha giatna in, iddo tapa, Berekiah tapa, Zekariah, zawlnei kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
heading: TOUPA'N Amite Kik Nawn Ding In Asam

paite: "Na pipute uh tung ah TOUPA nakpitak in alungkim kei hi," chi in.
Huaiziak in nang akiang uah, huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Ka kiang ah hong kik un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, huan na kiang uah ka hong kik ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi," chi in.

Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, "Tu in na omdan gilou ua kipan leh na thilhih giloute ua kipan hong kik un," chi a zawlnei masate'n agenna uh, na pipute uh bang in om kei un; himahleh amau hon za kei ua, hon ngaikhe sam kei uh, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Na pipute uh tua koi a omta ahi ua? Huan azawlneite uh tangtawn in ahing uhia?

Himahleh ka thute leh ka dan thusehte, ka sikha zawlneite thupiak a ka piakte, huaite'n na pipute uh delhphata uh ahi kei maw? Huan akihei ua, "Sepaihte' TOUPA'N i tung ua hih dia angaihtuah bang in, i omdan bang zel in leh i thilhihte bang zel a i tung ua hih ahita ve," achi uhi.
Darias akum nihna, Sebat kha, akha sawm-le-khat, ani sawmnih-le-li ni in, Iddo tapa, Berekiah tapa Zekariah, zawlnei kiang ah, TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
heading: Zekariah In Sakolte Muhna

paite: "Zan in mengmuhna in mi khat sakol san tung a tuang, munliap a om muisingte lak a dingh ka mu a, anunglam ah sakolte a-om ua, asan, asanpuang leh angou ahi uhi.
Huchi in 'Aw ka toupa, hiaite bang ahi ua?' ka chi a, huan kei hon houpih angel in ka kiang ah, ‘Hiaite bang ahi ua ka hon ensak ding,' achi hi.
Huai muising lak a dingpa'n adawng a, 'Hiaite leitung a kivialleh a vak dia TOUPA'N asawlte ahi uh,' achi hi.
"Huchi in huai muising lak a dingh TOUPA angel adawng ua, 'Leitung ah kivialleh in ka vakta ua, ngai in, leitung tengteng atu kinken a, akhawl dide hi,' " achi uhi.
Huan TOUPA angel in adawng a, "Aw sepaihte' TOUPA, hiai kum sawmsagih na hehkhum, Jerusalem tung leh Judah khopite tung ah bang tan zahngaihna nei lou ding na hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N thuhoihte, thu lungmuanhuaite a kei hon houpih angel adawng hi.
Huchi in kei hon houpih angel in ka kiang ah, hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Thikthu setak in Jerusalem leh Zion ka deihthoh ahi, chi in nang kikou in, chi in.
Huan bangmah awlmoh lou namte tung ah ka lungkim kei ding a; neukha lel a ka lung hih louh lai in, siatna athupisak semsem uhi.
Huaiziak in hichibang in TOUPA'N achi: Zahngaihnate toh Jerusalem ah ka kik nawnta a, asung ah inn lam ahi ding," chi in.
Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Hauhsakna ziak in ka khopite akiphalh ding a; TOUPA'N Zion alungmuan in, Jerusalem atel lai ding hi, chi in kikou behlap lai in," chi in.
Huan ka dak a, ngai in kii li ka mu hi.
heading: Kite Leh Siksekmi Muhna

paite: Kei hon houpih angel kiang ah, "Hiaite bang hi ding ahia?" ka chi a. Ama'n, "Hiaite Judah, Israel leh Jerusalem hawlzak mite ahi uh," chi in ahon dawng hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'n siksekmi li ahon ensak hi.

Huchi in ke'n, "Bang hih dia hiaite hong uh ahi ua?" ka chi hi. Ama'n thu agen a, "Kuamah in alu adaksaklouhna dia, Judah dalhzaksak hiai kiite ahi uh; himahleh hiaite, dalhzaksak ding a Judah gam tung a akii uh sangsak namte dou ding leh akiite uh paikhe ding a hong paite ahi uh," achi hi.
